A little later than usual, did not read so much, but interesting links of the week:

Strategy:

* https://informationsecuritynorthstar.com/ - build a better strategy
* https://patchwindow.com/ - an alternate view on the vulnpocalypse... it's the patches stupid

Threats:

* https://www.mitre.org/news-insights/news-release/mitre-attck-enterprise-add-ai-platform - the sound of AI walking the attack graph 🤖
* https://foo.be/threat-actor-explorer/misp-threat-actor-explorer.html - are FOOBAR and SLOPMONKEY related, find out
* https://www.skunkworkz.io/ - building a model trained on threats 🤖
* https://etbe.coker.com.au/2026/10/25/banks-phones/ - @etbe@mastodon.nzoss.nz talks banks, phones and opcos and what can go wrong

Bugs:

* https://v12.sh/blog/the-case-of-the-9bit-aes-key - first 4 and now sub-par AES

Exploitation:

* https://www.hacktron.ai/blog/hacking-gnu-savannah - all roads lead to GNU bugs

Hardening:

* https://codon.org.uk/~mjg59/blog/p/linux-lockdown-and-hibernation-again/ - @mjg59@nondeterministic.computer talks TPM
* https://www.ndss-symposium.org/wp-content/uploads/2026-f1725-paper.pdf - how best to harden Linux

#security, #research
